definitions.explanation: A gift or celebration given to someone who has moved into a new home.

examples.japanese: {新居祝|しんきょいわ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}ろう→贈る：09862_okuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What should I give as a housewarming gift?

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新居祝|しんきょいわ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave a towel set as a housewarming gift for my friend.

examples.japanese: {新居祝|しんきょいわ}い⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{観葉植物|かんようしょくぶつ}→観葉植物：19239_kanyoushokubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{好|この}み→好み：02767_konomi⟧や⟦{新居|しんきょ}→新居：19007_shinkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{広|ひろ}さ→広さ：00105_hirosa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧よい。
examples.english: Giving a houseplant as a housewarming gift is popular, but it's best to choose one suited to the recipient's taste and the size of their new home.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{新居|しんきょ}→新居：19007_shinkyo⟧ (new home) and ⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧ (celebration/gift). In Japanese gift-giving culture, it is customary to give {新居祝|しんきょいわ}い when someone moves into a newly built or newly purchased home.

Common gift choices include practical household items like tableware, towels, and kitchen tools. Items associated with fire (candles, ashtrays, red-colored items) are traditionally avoided because of the association with house fires.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新居祝|しんきょいわ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧: to give a housewarming gift
- {新居祝|しんきょいわ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧: to invite someone for a housewarming
- {新居祝|しんきょいわ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{返|かえ}し→お返し：08354_okaeshi⟧: return gift for housewarming

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{祝|いわ}い→引っ越し祝い：08494_hikkoshiiwai⟧: moving celebration — for any move, not just a new home
- {新築祝|しんちくいわ}い: gift for a newly built home (specifically new construction)
